purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Ol Kalou Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: IMPORTANT DEVIATION FROM STANDARD PATTERN, DOCUMENTED FOR TRANSPARENCY: unlike every other constituency reviewed in this tranche, the file the portal served for this form_id (Content-Disposition filename 'F34B-018-091-0000-000-00.PDF', matching county 018 / constituency 091 exactly, as with every other constituency) is a small (122 KB) born-digital vector PDF rather than a scanned paper form. It carries no IEBC letterhead banner, no 'CON 091' corner marker, no QR code, and no IEBC returning-officer stamp or candidate-agent signatures (the signature/handover page on page 3 of 3 is entirely blank). PDF metadata recovered from the file itself reads: title 'Form 34 B - T2', producer 'openhtmltopdf.com', creation date 2022-08-11T09:29:56+03:00 -- two days after the 9 August 2022 election, consistent with the constituency-level collation period, and generated by a PDF-rendering library rather than a scanner, which is consistent with this being an IEBC results-system-generated ('T2') rendition of the form rather than a scan of the signed paper original. The portal was reached via the same confirmed session handshake (home page + set-election id=5) used for every other constituency in this tranche, and the same form_id-to-constituency-code formula applied cleanly. Given the absence of the usual visual anti-fabrication markers, form identity here rests on: (a) the exact county/constituency match in the server's own Content-Disposition filename, (b) the constituency/county name and code printed in the document body ('OL KALOU', code 091, county 'NYANDARUA', code 018), and (c) the plausible election-period creation timestamp in the file's own metadata -- not on a visible printed banner marker as in the other tranche files.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (OL KALOU, code 091, county NYANDARUA code 018) was read from the page body text and cross-checked against the governed official source_url/form_id and the server's own Content-Disposition filename before this row was accepted; no 'CON 091' banner marker was available on this document (see review_context_note).

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: Registered voters, the four candidate cells, Total Valid Votes and Rejected Ballots are all clearly legible and fully self-consistent: registered voters (72,997) matches the governed P23 denominator exactly, and the candidate-column sum (47,326) reconciles exactly to the printed Total Valid Votes. However, this row is left unresolved rather than promoted because the source document itself deviates materially from the visual anti-fabrication identity check used for every other row in this tranche (see review_context_note for full detail): it is a small born-digital PDF with no IEBC letterhead, no 'CON 091' banner marker, no QR code, and a completely blank, unsigned candidate-agent/returning-officer signature page, rather than a scanned, stamped, hand-signed original. While the server's own Content-Disposition filename, the document body's constituency/county identity, and an election-period PDF creation timestamp are all consistent with this being IEBC's own system-generated rendition of the form, the absence of the usual signed/stamped scan is a meaningful deviation from this Atlas's established verification standard and is left for governed review rather than self-certified as promotion-eligible.
